ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-cream florets, matte surface with slight moisture, soft-firm texture, clustered pieces about 3-4 cm across with small stems, some light browning-free edges, sitting on the left side of the plate | 95
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow stem-like pieces, firm and slightly glossy, cut into elongated chunks about 4-5 cm long and 1-2 cm thick, sitting next to the florets on the left and lower-left of the plate | 45
ITEM 3 | Mixed fresh salad leaves in shades of green and dark green, some wilted and glossy with dressing, torn pieces about 5-8 cm across, spread across the right and center of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Dark purple-brown olives, glossy and smooth skinned, whole or halved, about 2-3 cm across, scattered among the greens and at the top right | 20
ITEM 5 | Light dressing or vinaigrette, translucent pale golden sheen with small orange-yellow seed-like specks pooled on and between the leaves | 10
ITEM 6 | Small white crumbles, soft and moist-looking, scattered in small pieces about 0.5-1 cm across among the leaves | 8
